note: Payloads only (the 4-byte opcode stripped), hand-built from the core's writers (GuildInvite::Write, GuildPackets.cpp:186-214; PlayerJoinedAppearance, :254-269; GuildCommandResult, :146-155) because no capture holds a guild packet. Every GUID is synthetic and every name is a run of one letter, so no original identifier is committed: the guild GUID is low word 2 with the guild type (28) in the high word, the type byte a packed GUID must carry (ObjectGuid.cpp operator>>), the joined player's is low word 3 with the player type nibble. Realm ids are 4242 and the emblem fields 1..5.
